title: Thomo Motseng oa Boholo-holo
intro: Motse oa boholo-holo o tletseng lerōle, batho ba oona ba tetebetse ho latola, le temoso ea ho qetela e sa kang ea eloa hloko. Kajeno, kena karolong ea ba rometsoeng ke Allah ho isa molaetsa ho batho ba manganga. Pale ea ho lahloa, lentsoe le le leng la tumelo, le qetello e tiisitsoeng ke taelo e senyang. Ke mang ea buang ka lintlha tsena?
clues: Re rometsoe ke Allah motseng oo batho ba oona ba neng ba furaletse 'nete.
Ba babeli ba rona ba ile ba tla pele, eaba oa boraro oa ikopanya ho matlafatsa thomo ea rona
Baahi ba toropo ba ile ba re hana, ba re re batho feela ba kang bona
Motho a le mong feela ea tsoang pheletsong e hōle ea motse o ile a matha ho ea bolella batho hore ba re latele.
Re ile ra ba rapella, empa ba thatafatsa lipelo tsa bona 'me ba re fetohela
Ka mohoo o le mong o bohloko o tsoang maholimong, motse oa rona oohle o ile oa khutsisoa

identity.label: Ke mang?
options: Baromuoa ba Toropo ho Surah Ya-Sin
Hawwariyyun (Barutuoa ba Isa)
Baloi ba Ntlo ea Faro
Metsoalle ea Sabatha
Batho ba Tlou
identity.answer: Baromuoa ba Toropo ho Surah Ya-Sin

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Batho ba toropo ba ile ba hana 'me ba bitsoa ba leshano
Ho chesoa a ntse a phela mollong o moholo o tukang
E metse ke tlhapi e kholo botebong ba leoatle
Ho qobelloa ho sebetsa ka thata ho haha ​​​​pilara e telele
O hlokofalitsoe ka har'a foro ea mollo o tukang
trial.answer: Batho ba toropo ba ile ba hana 'me ba bitsoa ba leshano

location.label: Karolo ea Bohlokoa
options: Motse oa boholo-holo (al-Qaryah)
Sebōpi se seholo se tukang
Mpa ea tlhapi e kholo
Pilara e phahameng e amang leholimo
Ntlo e halalelang (Kaaba)

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: Toropo e ile ea senngoa ke mohoo o le mong o senyang (Sayha)
Mohatelli le lebotho la hae ba ile ba khangoa ke metsi leoatleng le arohaneng
Batho ba ile ba fetoha litšoene le litšoene
Pula ea majoe a tsoang leholimong e ile ea senya motse
Moroallo o matla o ile oa hohola sechaba sohle
outcome.answer: Toropo e ile ea senngoa ke mohoo o le mong o senyang (Sayha)

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
